name: MFCB
recent: Mega First 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，净利同比下滑 19%，主要受合资企业财务恶化拖累。同期，主席兼执行董事 Goh Nan Kioh 在闭市期间多次增持公司股份。此外，公司出现在多家媒体的交易想法名单中。
notable: 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，净利同比下滑 19%。
主席兼执行董事 Goh Nan Kioh 在 11 月 18 日至 24 日期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 合资企业财务恶化拖累整体盈利。
第三季度净利同比下滑 19%，盈利呈下降趋势。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收为 3.287 亿令吉，环比增长 7.8%，但同比下降 3.3%；净利为 5,939 万令吉，环比下降 4.7%，同比下降 29.9%，净利率从上一季度的 20.4% 降至 18.1%。

recent_en: Mega First reported a 19% year-on-year decline in 3Q net profit, mainly dragged by financial deterioration at a joint venture. Meanwhile, Chairman & Executive Director Goh Nan Kioh acquired shares multiple times during the closed period. The company also appeared in several media trading ideas lists.
notable_en: Announced 3Q 2026 results with net profit down 19% year-on-year.
Chairman & Executive Director Goh Nan Kioh acquired shares multiple times between 18 and 24 November.
risks_en: Financial deterioration at a joint venture weighed on overall earnings.
3Q net profit fell 19% year-on-year, showing a declining earnings trend.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 revenue was MYR 328.7 million, up 7.8% QoQ but down 3.3% YoY; net income was MYR 59.39 million, down 4.7% QoQ and 29.9% YoY, with net margin falling to 18.1% from 20.4% in the previous quarter.
